environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Task role has s3:PutObject on the processing bucket. No WAF attached. Container runs as root with read-write filesystem.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM server certificate, no mutual TLS
